method: Untouched ZIP local records are copied as compressed bytes without decompression. Updated entries are written from reviewed files. No original entry is deleted.
tests: 72 offline tests passed (37 transport/chat + 26 analysis + 9 history). Browser checks: saved report tab switching/reload generated zero calculation requests; 5000 synthetic city records with 30 DOM rows per page. City/chat browser checks passed: lowered camera and whole-city fit on desktop/mobile, WASD, editable-field exclusion, header catalogue, progressive reply, paired cards, manual scroll hold and reduced motion. Layout checks passed: four city viewport sizes with mutually exclusive side panels and measured header/footer clearance; nine narrow-screen views with disclosures open; edge popover, resized popover, modal footer and modal stacking. No live model requests.
